channel.title: Tim Reska, blog
channel.description: Two news radars, one on AI coding tools and one on nanopore sequencing and metagenomics, plus occasional longer posts.

item.title: Nanopore and Metagenomics Radar, 16 October 2026
item.description: Rapid metagenomics changed treatment for 26% of samples in a paediatric intensive care unit, wastewater resistance signals turn out to depend on the host species, and a quiet three weeks for nanopore software. Covers 25 September to 16 October 2026.

item.title: AI News Radar, 16 October 2026
item.description: Four new models in three weeks, a round of model retirements that will break pinned configs, and research showing coding-agent benchmark scores are inflated by about a third. Covers 25 September to 16 October 2026.
